title: GoOrganicAfrica Senegal calculator readiness research — Batch 34
executive_summary: Added a 2025 SODAGRI campaign table extraction for selected crops in five intervention regions and refreshed the EAA 2024/25 data-access and 2026/27 marketing-policy findings. Senegal remains directory-only; national survey extraction, farmgate prices, input-cost distributions and enterprise budgets are not yet complete.

geography.source: Existing official Senegal region selector; EAA 2024/25 covers all 14 regions and 45 departments. Anonymised microdata retains region but replaces department with agroecological zone.

extracted_campaign_2025.scope: SODAGRI intervention area only: Kolda, Sédhiou, Ziguinchor, Tambacounda and Kédougou
extracted_campaign_2025.units: area ha; production t; ratio t/ha calculated as production divided by area
extracted_campaign_2025.caveat: These are five-region SODAGRI intervention totals, not national totals. Ratios are calculated from the published table and not necessarily survey yield observations or comparable production systems.

market_and_policy.finding: 2026/27 peanut producer price was not yet fixed in the cited official decision; a committee was assigned to recommend an annual price. Cotton marketing opens 15 November 2026; peanut collection opens late November.
market_and_policy.non_price_support: Government decision includes 50 FCFA/kg support to rice mills; it is not a farmgate price paid to growers.

safeguards: Do not extrapolate SODAGRI five-region totals to all 14 regions.
Do not call calculated production/area ratios official survey yields.
Do not use rice-mill support as a farmgate price.
Do not enter a 2026/27 peanut producer price before official publication.
Respect DAPSA microdata confidentiality and authorisation requirements.
No active calculator profiles or formulas changed.

Obtain farmgate prices by crop, grade, market, date and region; update the 2026/27 groundnut price only when formally published.
Extract farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, crop-protection and labour costs from authorised aggregate data.
Obtain machinery, irrigation, energy, land, transport and livestock enterprise cost data.
Build regional enterprise budgets by production system, map the 17 supported commodities and create regression test cases.
